seo_title: AI Grant Agent: Filter SME Funding | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Losing public funding due to lack of time? We integrate an AI Agent that tracks official bulletins, filters B2B grants, and alerts your SME if eligible.
author_pitch: I have seen too many SMEs leave thousands of euros on the table because they cannot review official bulletins daily. With Artificial Intelligence, we transform unreadable bureaucracy into actionable notifications, so you only apply for the grants you can actually win.
title: AI Agent for B2B Grants: Automate Your Public Funding Acquisition
body:
Are you losing thousands of euros a year because funding calls expire before you even notice?

For a small business or startup, checking official bulletins, ministries, and European funds daily is humanly impossible. The bureaucratic language is dense, technical requirements are hidden in endless annexes, and deadlines are ridiculously short. In the end, the same large corporations secure the funds simply because they have entire departments dedicated to reading official gazettes, while your business loses vital funding opportunities.

The trap of generic alerts

Subscribing to consulting newsletters or using public search engines only floods your inbox with hundreds of irrelevant emails that you never open. You don't need more noise; you need to know if your specific Tax ID complies with article 4 of the call. The true competitive advantage is not accessing information, it is processing it instantly.

Our solution: AI Grant Triage Engine

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we deploy an autonomous AI Agent specifically designed for your SME. We connect advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) models to public repositories. The AI reads, understands, and cross-references each new publication with your company's tax, technological, and billing data in real-time.

  1. 24/7 Multi-source Tracking: Automated extraction from state, regional, and European databases without manual intervention.
  2. Semantic Parsing of Legal Bases: Technical breakdown of bureaucratic PDFs to extract only the exclusionary requirements, deadlines, and maximum amounts.
  3. Custom Feasibility Scoring: Data cross-referencing through RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with your company profile to assign a success probability score to each grant.
  4. Enriched Alerts via Slack or Email: Direct notifications to your management team only when the match level exceeds 90%, including a three-line executive summary.

The Real Impact on Your Cash Flow

  • Zero hours wasted on bureaucracy: You eliminate the need to read hundreds of legal pages every week looking for opportunities.
  • Maximized conversion rate: Your agency only drafts projects for those grants where the AI has already technically validated your absolute eligibility.
  • Critical time advantage: You are the first to apply the exact day the call opens, securing funds in non-competitive grants before they run out.
